# Public metadata fixtures

MusicBrainz responses for the reference discs are used only by the host tests.
The Blunderbuss album description comes from the English Wikipedia article
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blunderbuss_(album), via Wikidata Q886366 and its
MusicBrainz relationship. Wikipedia text is available under CC BY-SA; see
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Copyrights.

The settings fixture is synthetic. No user logs, saved preferences, cover-art
assets or CD audio recordings are included here. Preview artwork is fetched
separately into the ignored build cache.
